license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

issuing_authority.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself out as qualified to practice medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, or podiatry without obtaining a license from the Board of Medicine as provided in this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: Is 18 years of age or more;

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (or equivalent podiatric medical degree)
degree_required.quote: Has successfully completed all or such part as may be prescribed by the Board, of an educational course of study of that branch of the healing arts in which he desires a license to practice, which course of study and the educational institution providing that course of study are acceptable to the Board

accrediting_body.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or other recognized accrediting agency
accrediting_body.quote: the Board may consider the reputation of the institution and whether it is approved or accredited by regional or national educational or professional associations, including such organizations as the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

required.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

duration.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

kind.quote: postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners examinations
exams.notes: Minimum passing score determined by the Board prior to administration
exams.quote: The examination of candidates for licensure to practice podiatry shall be the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners examinations and such other examinations as determined by the Board.

interval_years.quote: Every license granted under the provisions of this chapter shall be renewed biennially as prescribed by the Board.

required.quote: The Board shall prescribe by regulation such requirements as may be necessary to ensure continued practitioner competence, which may include continuing education, testing, or any other requirement.

available.quote: The Board, in its discretion, may issue certificates or licenses to applicants upon endorsement by boards or other appropriate authorities of other states or territories or the District of Columbia with which reciprocal relations have not been established if the credentials of such applicants are satisfactory and the examinations and passing grades required by such other boards are fully equal to those required by the Virginia Board.

requirements.value: Credentials must be satisfactory and examinations and passing grades must be fully equal to those required by the Virginia Board; or applicant holds a national board certificate with acceptable credentials, school of graduation, and examination results.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue certificates or licenses to applicants holding certificates from the national boards of their respective branches of the healing arts if their credentials, schools of graduation and national board examinations and results are acceptable to the Board.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

title_protection.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing the healing arts who actually engages in such practice as defined in this chapter, or who opens an office for such purpose, or who advertises or announces to the public in any manner a readiness to practice or who uses in connection with his name the words or letters "Doctor," "Dr.," "M.D.," "D.O.," "D.P.M.," "D.C.,"

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False statements, representations, fraud, or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of any branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False statements or representations or fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to the practice, or fraud or deceit in the practice of any branch of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance abuse rendering the licensee unfit for professional obligations and duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Substance abuse rendering him unfit for the performance of his professional obligations and duties;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice with safety to patients and the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Restriction of a license to practice in another state, DC, US possession or territory, or foreign jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Restriction of a license to practice a branch of the healing arts in another state, the District of Columbia, a United States possession or territory, or a foreign jurisdiction, or for an entity of the federal government;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking to procure or perform or aid in procuring or performing a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking in any manner or by any means whatsoever to procure or perform or aid or abet in procuring or performing a criminal abortion;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances with intent that they be used other than medicinally or for accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used otherwise than medicinally, or for accepted therapeutic purposes, or with intent to evade any law with respect to the sale, use, or disposition of such drug;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions on division of fees or practicing in violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating provisions of this chapter on division of fees or practicing any branch of the healing arts in violation of the provisions of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully committing a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude under Commonwealth or US law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully committing an act that is a felony under the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States, or any act that is a misdemeanor under such laws and involves moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending name to a person known to be practicing illegally
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending his name to any person known to him to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice contrary to the standards of ethics of the branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of his branch of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner that is a danger to the health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing an advertisement relating to professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board regulations governing advertising;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any statute or regulation relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of statute or regulation, state or federal, relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or cooperating with others in violating provisions of the healing arts chapters or Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any of the provisions of Chapters 1 (§ 54.1-100 et seq.), 24 (§ 54.1-2400 et seq.) and this chapter or regulations of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with the practitioner-patient relationship or other lewd conduct during the relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner and patient relationship or otherwise engaging at any time during the course of the practitioner and patient relationship in conduct of a sexual nature that a reasonable patient would consider lewd and offensive;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if still in effect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if such adjudication is in effect and the person has not been declared restored to competence or capacity;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing medical examiner services without being listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing the services of a medical examiner as defined in 49 C.F.R. § 390.5 if, at the time such services are performed, the person performing such services is not listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically any medical certification in accordance with death registration requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically using the Electronic Death Registration System any medical certification in accordance with the requirements of subsection C of § 32.1-263.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a pattern of violations of § 38.2-3445.01
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a pattern of violations of § 38.2-3445.01.

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatry means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle, including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle, but does not include amputation of the foot proximal to the transmetatarsal level through the metatarsal shafts.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle, including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle, but does not include amputation of the foot proximal to the transmetatarsal level through the metatarsal shafts.

methods_authorized.quote: including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may administer or provide controlled substances to patients in bona fide medical emergencies or when pharmaceutical services are not available; may not sell controlled substances without Board of Pharmacy licensure
drug_authority.quote: this prohibition shall not apply to a doctor of medicine, osteopathy or podiatry who administers controlled substances to his patients or provides controlled substances to his patient in a bona fide medical emergency or when pharmaceutical services are not available.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle

amputation_authorized.quote: does not include amputation of the foot proximal to the transmetatarsal level through the metatarsal shafts. Amputations proximal to the metatarsal-phalangeal joints may only be performed in a hospital or ambulatory surgery facility accredited by an organization listed in § 54.1-2939.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatrists shall not perform surgery on patients under a general anesthetic except in a hospital or an ambulatory surgery center accredited by a national accrediting organization granted authority by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle, including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Podiatrists shall not perform surgery on patients under a general anesthetic except in a hospital or an ambulatory surgery center accredited by a national accrediting organization granted authority by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to assure compliance with Medicare conditions of participation pursuant to § 1865 of Title XVIII of the Social Security Act

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: The practice includes the diagnosis and treatment of lower extremity ulcers; however, the treatment of severe lower extremity ulcers proximal to the foot and ankle may only be performed by appropriately trained, credentialed podiatrists in an approved hospital or ambulatory surgery center at which the podiatrist has privileges

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations for the prescribing of opioids and products containing buprenorphine.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: The practice includes the diagnosis and treatment of lower extremity ulcers; however, the treatment of severe lower extremity ulcers proximal to the foot and ankle may only be performed by appropriately trained, credentialed podiatrists in an approved hospital or ambulatory surgery center at which the podiatrist has privileges, as described in § 54.1-2939.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A patient care team physician or patient care team podiatrist licensed under this chapter may serve on a patient care team with physician assistants and shall provide collaboration and consultation to such physician assistants.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A certified registered nurse anesthetist shall practice under the supervision of a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, podiatry, or dentistry

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: "Practice of surgical assisting" means the performance of significant surgical tasks, including manipulation of organs, suturing of tissue, placement of hemostatic agents, injection of local anesthetic, harvesting of veins, implementation of devices, and other duties as directed by a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry under the direct supervision of a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry.

office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.quote: Amputations proximal to the metatarsal-phalangeal joints may only be performed in a hospital or ambulatory surgery facility accredited by an organization listed in § 54.1-2939.
